gold: Trifascicular heart block (Bifascicular block with first-degree AV block progressing to complete heart block)

selector.rationale: Evidence of first-degree and third-degree AV block, as well as Mobitz type I second-degree AV block, supports Lev Cardiac Conduction Disease as the most specific diagnosis.

rejected.why: While left atrial enlargement and pulmonary hypertension are present, they are not specific enough to outweigh the conduction abnormalities.

rejected.label: Pulmonary hypertension
rejected.why: Pulmonary hypertension is a finding, but it is not the primary diagnosis given the prominent conduction abnormalities.
